dispur: How did Dispur grow from a village into a busy part of Guwahati?

jalukbari: Why is Jalukbari such an important junction?

north-guwahati: How many bridges now link North Guwahati with the city?

What is the history of North Guwahati?

It was the site of the ancient city of Durjaya, a capital of the Kamarupa kingdom, and it still has old temples. North Guwahati, on the north bank of the Brahmaputra, is being gradually incorporated into the city limits, with housing more spread out than in the city.
